title: A Unified Model for Motion-Conditioned Robot Co-design
excerpt: Transformer Transformer: A Unified Model for Motion-Conditioned Robot Co-design. Project website.

Transformer Transformer

Huy Ha, Karen Liu, Shuran Song

Not all robots are created equal

Not all robots are created equal — but what if you could design one for a specific task? We propose Transformer Transformer, a unified model that does exactly this: hand it a manipulation demonstration, and it generates a complete robot — every link, joint, motor, and inertial property — optimized for that motion. We fabricated one such design for cloth flinging on an ALOHA2 bimanual platform; it reduced tracking error by 73% and max joint speed by 30% versus the original.

Behind that result is a diffusion transformer trained on RoboTokens, a unified tokenization of robot embodiments, states, and actions. The same architecture spans embodiment spaces (wheeled bimanual, quadrupeds, humanoids) and use cases (embodiment generation, cross-embodiment control). Rather than overfitting to one reward function, it is a dynamics model whose reward-agnostic predictions are converted into reward-specific value predictions at inference time, then used to steer embodiment diffusion through a procedure we call Dynamics Self-Guidance. Experiments across three design spaces show zero-shot optimization of unseen rewards and trajectories, improving performance and runtime over an evolutionary baseline.

Technical Summary Video

A 17-minute walkthrough — or scroll for the figure-and-caption version.

What is the best robot
for a given manipulation task?

A robot's embodiment decides what tasks it can do well. We pour effort into making robots smarter — bigger datasets, better algorithms, more capable policy architectures — but a bad embodiment can hamper even a great policy. You can collect all the tossing data in the world, but if your robot's shape is far from optimal, it might toss itself instead of the ball.

So let's frame the problem concretely. Given as input a target end-effector motion and a reward function, we want to generate a complete robot embodiment for the task — by complete we mean every link, joint, motor, and inertial property, plus a controller that drives the whole thing. We call this motion-conditioned robot co-design.

A randomly procedurally-generated robot attempting the target motion: it falls before it can finish 🙃

Demonstrate, Generate, Validate

Our framework reframes robot co-design as a three-step process: you demonstrate the desired end-effector motion (e.g., from a UMI3 human demonstration), our model generates an optimized embodiment, and the same model validates the design by directly controlling it. The same network plays three roles — generator, critic, and cross-embodiment controller — by training jointly on one unified tokenization of robots.

The paper has three parts: a unified robot representation (RoboTokens), a unified architecture (Transformer Transformer), and a unified training objective (Dynamics Self-Guidance). You have until the architecture section to figure out the pun 🥸

PART 1

RoboTokens
A Unified Robot Representation

If we want one model to co-design any robot, the network needs a shared vocabulary that spans every embodiment. RoboTokens are that vocabulary: typed tokens for every link, joint, motor, state, and action — organized so a single sequence describes both a robot's embodiment (time-invariant) and its dynamics (time-varying).

RoboTokens has the following key design goals:

  • Complete. A RoboToken sequence captures everything about a rigid articulated robot: 5 embodiment token types (links, fixed joints, rotating/sliding joints, ball joints, motors) plus state and action tokens.
  • Flexible. Tokens reference each other by ID — a joint token knows the two link tokens it connects — so the same format handles a 6-DoF arm or a 35-DoF biped.
  • Consistent. The tokenizer canonicalizes redundant spatial offsets and stores inertial / transform data in a single frame, reducing the variance the model has to learn through.
  • Extensible. New token types slot in without changing the architecture — we add target end-effector pose tokens for trajectory tracking by pointing them at the relevant end-effector and timestep IDs, no retokenization of the rest of the robot required.
  • Optimizable. Unlike autoregressive text formats like MJCF, diffusing continuous-valued RoboTokens gives both global controllability (later tokens influence earlier ones across denoising steps) and differentiability — the two ingredients needed for gradient-based reward optimization at inference time.

We tokenized 11 robots from the MuJoCo Menagerie10, spanning two orders of magnitude in mass (0.65 kg dexterous hand to 67.5 kg quadruped) and from 6 to 35 active joints. Each became a sequence of 28–101 RoboTokens — small enough to diffuse end-to-end.

PART 2

Transformer Transformer
A Unified Architecture

The model is a diffusion transformer (DiT1) trained on RoboTokens with a DDIM4 noise schedule. Noise is added to every input token except the ones we condition on — and by changing which tokens are masked, the same network wears different hats. Mask everything to get an unconditional robot generator. Mask the actions and you get a cross-embodiment controller5,6. Mask the embodiment and you get a motion-conditioned robot designer. Same weights, jointly trained on dynamics.

(And about the pun: the first “Transformer” refers to robots whose embodiments can change. The second refers to the self-attention architecture 🥸)

An embodiment-aware controller

Because the controller sees the full embodiment as input, it can adjust its control strategy to the robot it's driving. Change link inertias, joint ranges, or motor gains, and the same policy keeps tracking — without any retraining per robot. We behavior-cloned whole-body controllers from RL experts7,8,9 trained one-per-design on the procedural quadruped space.

One policy, many quadrupeds. The same controller tracks the same trajectory across quadrupeds with continuous variations (link dimensions) and discrete variations (DoF, knee direction, spring-loaded vs serial leg).

A generator over diverse robot classes

Run the model with no conditioning at all and it diffuses out complete robots from Gaussian noise. Trained on diverse robots from Menagerie10, a single Transformer Transformer produces fixed-base arms, quadrupeds, humanoids, and dexterous hands. Because diffusion is stochastic, every run gives different robots.

Robots, diffused. A single model generates fixed-base arms, quadrupeds, humanoids, and dexterous hands from the same noise schedule.

PART 3

Dynamics Self-Guidance
Zero-shotting Rewards

Now the actual co-design problem: how do we generate a high-reward robot for a reward function the model has never seen during training?

Here is the trick. The same model predicts both the embodiment and its dynamics, so we can feed those predictions into the user's reward function and get a predicted reward. With predicted rewards in hand, we can run the model many times in parallel, predict the reward for each candidate, and return the best one. That is best-of-N sampling, but at GPU speed.

We can do better. Because the predicted reward is a differentiable function of the embodiment tokens, we can take its gradient and inject it back into the diffusion process — pushing samples toward higher reward at every denoising step, following classifier-guided DDIM11. The model is, in effect, asking itself: “how should this robot change to increase the reward?” We call this Dynamics Self-Guidance.

Why “self-guidance”: related work that incorporates dynamics into diffusion guidance trains a separate dynamics model12 or relies on a differentiable simulator13. Here, the model uses its own dynamics predictions to steer itself.

Reward in, robot out

Take a randomly-generated quadruped that falls during a dynamic toss. Ask our model to generate a robot for the same trajectory with only a tracking reward and it lowers the center of mass and widens the support polygon — stable design choices it discovered as a side-effect of trying to maximize tracking reward it has never seen.

Now add a torque-penalty term and the optimization landscape shifts. The model returns a smaller, lighter robot — still tracking the motion, but using 30% less average torque. Add a size penalty and the landscape shifts again. This is what people might call zero-shotting rewards: train on dynamics modeling, optimize at inference for any reward you can write down.

Composing diffusion models for whole datasets

Manipulation isn't one motion; it's a distribution of motions. We want to optimize a robot for an entire task — say, dish washing — not a single trajectory. Diffusion composition14,15 lets us do exactly this: run the model in parallel with different trajectories as conditioning, average the predicted noise at each diffusion step, and you get a generator optimized for all of them simultaneously.

We tested this on the publicly-available UMI bimanual dish-washing dataset3, holding out 26 validation trajectories. Transformer Transformer generated robots optimized over the entire held-out distribution — navigating both the discrete space (spine designs: fixed, sliding, bending) and the continuous space (arm dimensions, mounting offsets) — and the same model then served as the cross-embodiment controller to validate each generated design.

One robot, a whole task. Composed across the 26 held-out UMI dish-washing trajectories, the model returns a single embodiment optimized for the entire distribution — and the same network then drives it through each motion.

Better Designs, Faster

We compare against two baselines: Random (sample a robot from the procedural design space) and CMA-ES16, a black-box optimizer widely used in co-design. CMA-ES rolls out candidate robots in MuJoCo17 with the design space's controller (Mink18 for fixed-base / bimanual; an RL expert7 for legged robots), then biases the next generation toward higher-reward samples.

We give all methods the same task: generate a robot for a target trajectory and reward, control it, report the achieved reward.

Test-time compute scales the results

Like large language models that get better with longer thinking19, Transformer Transformer gets better designs when given more inference seeds to sample over. Performance does eventually plateau after about a minute — unlike the seemingly endless gains LLMs get from longer reasoning. We discuss this in the limitations.

Why so much faster? Two reasons multiply. (1) GPU parallelization over candidate designs. (2) Non-autoregressive diffusion evaluates an entire rollout in parallel rather than one timestep at a time. Typical learned dynamics models predict one step at a time; we predict the whole episode at once.

Real-World: Cloth Flinging on ALOHA

Original ALOHA vs Transformer Transformer-optimized ALOHA. Same task, same target trajectory, two robots. The optimized design unfolds the cloth where the original cannot.

To stress-test the whole system on hardware, we picked dynamic cloth unfolding on ALOHA2. Flinging20 punishes embodiment mistakes through both kinematics (the arm has to reach over the cloth at high speed) and unmodeled dynamics (aerodynamic drag, cloth weight, friction). The original ALOHA design struggled to even track the trajectory.

We asked our model to optimize the ALOHA design for the “Tracking Velocity” reward, then fabricated the resulting design. Two things changed compared to the original:

  • Longer link lengths. Just enough to kinematically reach across the flinging trajectory, but light enough to stay within the Dynamixel motor torque envelope.
  • Inverted mounting. The arms hang upside-down behind the workspace, enabling an energy-efficient underarm swing instead of an overhead fling.

Limitations & Future Work

Geometry and scene. RoboTokens currently cover primitive-based geometry, not arbitrary meshes or deformables, and don't yet encode the surrounding scene or contact targets. Extending to complex geometry and scene context is a clear next step toward fully task-conditioned co-design.

Controller transfer. Our cross-embodiment controller correlates with the RL oracle at Pearson r = 0.53 on diffused embodiments — promising but with headroom. Some outlier embodiments expose where the controller fails to generalize.

Test-time scaling plateau. Like other guided-diffusion methods, our test-time compute gains plateau after about a minute. Unlike LLMs19, more inference time stops helping past a point. Improving reward-prediction accuracy and alternative inference schemes are open directions.

Data generation cost. RL-based whole-body controller data generation is expensive (one RL expert per discrete design choice, 16 hours of A100 per policy). Scaling Transformer Transformer to new design spaces hinges on reducing this cost.

blocks.html_en: Not all robots are created equal — but what if you could design one for a specific task? We propose Transformer Transformer, a unified model that does exactly this: hand it a manipulation demonstration, and it generates a complete robot — every link, joint, motor, and inertial property — optimized for that motion. We fabricated one such design for cloth flinging on an ALOHA2 bimanual platform; it reduced tracking error by 73% and max joint speed by 30% versus the original.

sentences.en: We propose Transformer Transformer, a unified model that does exactly this: hand it a manipulation demonstration, and it generates a complete robot — every link, joint, motor, and inertial property — optimized for that motion.
sentences.zh: 我们提出了 Transformer Transformer，这是一个统一的模型，它正是这样做的：给它一个操作演示，它会生成一个完整的机器人——每个连杆、关节、电机和惯性属性——针对该运动进行了优化。

sentences.en: We fabricated one such design for cloth flinging on an ALOHA2 bimanual platform; it reduced tracking error by 73% and max joint speed by 30% versus the original.
sentences.zh: 我们制作了这样一种设计，用于在 ALOHA2 双手平台上投掷布料；与原来相比，它减少了 73% 的跟踪误差和 30% 的最大关节速度。

blocks.html_en: Behind that result is a diffusion transformer trained on RoboTokens, a unified tokenization of robot embodiments, states, and actions. The same architecture spans embodiment spaces (wheeled bimanual, quadrupeds, humanoids) and use cases (embodiment generation, cross-embodiment control). Rather than overfitting to one reward function, it is a dynamics model whose reward-agnostic predictions are converted into reward-specific value predictions at inference time, then used to steer embodiment diffusion through a procedure we call Dynamics Self-Guidance. Experiments across three design spaces show zero-shot optimization of unseen rewards and trajectories, improving performance and runtime over an evolutionary baseline.

blocks.html_en: A robot's embodiment decides what tasks it can do well. We pour effort into making robots smarter — bigger datasets, better algorithms, more capable policy architectures — but a bad embodiment can hamper even a great policy. You can collect all the tossing data in the world, but if your robot's shape is far from optimal, it might toss itself instead of the ball.

sentences.zh: 机器人的具体体现决定了它能胜任哪些任务。

blocks.html_en: So let's frame the problem concretely. Given as input a target end-effector motion and a reward function, we want to generate a complete robot embodiment for the task — by complete we mean every link, joint, motor, and inertial property, plus a controller that drives the whole thing. We call this motion-conditioned robot co-design.

sentences.en: We call this motion-conditioned robot co-design.

blocks.html_en: Our framework reframes robot co-design as a three-step process: you demonstrate the desired end-effector motion (e.g., from a UMI3 human demonstration), our model generates an optimized embodiment, and the same model validates the design by directly controlling it. The same network plays three roles — generator, critic, and cross-embodiment controller — by training jointly on one unified tokenization of robots.

sentences.en: Our framework reframes robot co-design as a three-step process: you demonstrate the desired end-effector motion (e.g., from a UMI3 human demonstration), our model generates an optimized embodiment, and the same model validates the design by directly controlling it.

blocks.html_en: PART 1

RoboTokens
A Unified Robot Representation

sentences.en: RoboTokens A Unified Robot Representation
sentences.zh: RoboTokens 统一的机器人表示

sentences.en: Every robot becomes a typed token sequence.
sentences.zh: 每个机器人都成为一个键入的令牌序列。

sentences.en: Blue tokens encode embodiment (links, joints, motors); orange tokens encode dynamics (states and actions).
sentences.zh: 蓝色标记编码实施例（连杆、关节、电机）；橙色标记编码动态（状态和动作）。

sentences.en: The same tokenizer ingests a quadruped, a humanoid, or a dexterous hand — no per-robot adapter — so a single model can learn across all of them.
sentences.zh: 同一个分词器可以摄取四足动物、人形动物或灵巧的手——没有每个机器人适配器——因此单个模型可以学习所有这些动物。

blocks.html_en: If we want one model to co-design any robot, the network needs a shared vocabulary that spans every embodiment. RoboTokens are that vocabulary: typed tokens for every link, joint, motor, state, and action — organized so a single sequence describes both a robot's embodiment (time-invariant) and its dynamics (time-varying).

sentences.en: If we want one model to co-design any robot, the network needs a shared vocabulary that spans every embodiment.
sentences.zh: 如果我们想要一个模型来共同设计任何机器人，网络需要一个跨越每个实施例的共享词汇表。

sentences.en: RoboTokens are that vocabulary: typed tokens for every link, joint, motor, state, and action — organized so a single sequence describes both a robot's embodiment (time-invariant) and its dynamics (time-varying).
sentences.zh: RoboTokens 就是这样的词汇表：每个链接、关节、电机、状态和动作的键入令牌 — 被组织起来，以便单个序列描述机器人的体现（时不变）及其动态（时变）。

blocks.html_en: RoboTokens has the following key design goals:

sentences.en: RoboTokens has the following key design goals:
sentences.zh: RoboTokens 有以下主要设计目标：

blocks.html_en: • Complete. A RoboToken sequence captures everything about a rigid articulated robot: 5 embodiment token types (links, fixed joints, rotating/sliding joints, ball joints, motors) plus state and action tokens.

sentences.en: Complete.
sentences.zh: 完全的。

sentences.en: A RoboToken sequence captures everything about a rigid articulated robot: 5 embodiment token types (links, fixed joints, rotating/sliding joints, ball joints, motors) plus state and action tokens.
sentences.zh: RoboToken 序列捕获有关刚性关节式机器人的所有内容：5 种实施例令牌类型（连杆、固定关节、旋转/滑动关节、球关节、电机）以及状态和动作令牌。

blocks.html_en: • Flexible. Tokens reference each other by ID — a joint token knows the two link tokens it connects — so the same format handles a 6-DoF arm or a 35-DoF biped.

sentences.en: Flexible.
sentences.zh: 灵活的。

sentences.en: Tokens reference each other by ID — a joint token knows the two link tokens it connects — so the same format handles a 6-DoF arm or a 35-DoF biped.
sentences.zh: 令牌通过 ID 相互引用——关节令牌知道它连接的两个链接令牌——因此相同的格式可以处理 6 自由度手臂或 35 自由度两足动物。

blocks.html_en: • Consistent. The tokenizer canonicalizes redundant spatial offsets and stores inertial / transform data in a single frame, reducing the variance the model has to learn through.

sentences.en: Consistent.
sentences.zh: 持续的。

sentences.en: The tokenizer canonicalizes redundant spatial offsets and stores inertial / transform data in a single frame, reducing the variance the model has to learn through.
sentences.zh: 分词器规范化冗余空间偏移并将惯性/变换数据存储在单个帧中，从而减少模型必须学习的方差。

blocks.html_en: • Extensible. New token types slot in without changing the architecture — we add target end-effector pose tokens for trajectory tracking by pointing them at the relevant end-effector and timestep IDs, no retokenization of the rest of the robot required.

sentences.en: Extensible.
sentences.zh: 可扩展。

sentences.en: New token types slot in without changing the architecture — we add target end-effector pose tokens for trajectory tracking by pointing them at the relevant end-effector and timestep IDs, no retokenization of the rest of the robot required.
sentences.zh: 新的令牌类型无需更改架构即可插入 - 我们通过将目标末端执行器姿势令牌指向相关的末端执行器和时间步 ID 来添加用于轨迹跟踪的令牌，无需对机器人的其余部分进行重新令牌化。

blocks.html_en: • Optimizable. Unlike autoregressive text formats like MJCF, diffusing continuous-valued RoboTokens gives both global controllability (later tokens influence earlier ones across denoising steps) and differentiability — the two ingredients needed for gradient-based reward optimization at inference time.

sentences.en: Optimizable.
sentences.zh: 可优化。

sentences.en: Unlike autoregressive text formats like MJCF, diffusing continuous-valued RoboTokens gives both global controllability (later tokens influence earlier ones across denoising steps) and differentiability — the two ingredients needed for gradient-based reward optimization at inference time.
sentences.zh: 与 MJCF 等自回归文本格式不同，扩散连续值 RoboToken 既具有全局可控性（后来的令牌在去噪步骤中影响早期的令牌）又具有可微性——这是推理时基于梯度的奖励优化所需的两个要素。

blocks.html_en: We tokenized 11 robots from the MuJoCo Menagerie10, spanning two orders of magnitude in mass (0.65 kg dexterous hand to 67.5 kg quadruped) and from 6 to 35 active joints. Each became a sequence of 28–101 RoboTokens — small enough to diffuse end-to-end.

sentences.en: We tokenized 11 robots from the MuJoCo Menagerie10, spanning two orders of magnitude in mass (0.65 kg dexterous hand to 67.5 kg quadruped) and from 6 to 35 active joints.
sentences.zh: 我们对来自 MuJoCo Menagerie10 的 11 个机器人进行了标记，其质量跨越两个数量级（0.65 公斤灵巧手到 67.5 公斤四足动物）和 6 到 35 个活动关节。

sentences.en: Each became a sequence of 28–101 RoboTokens — small enough to diffuse end-to-end.
sentences.zh: 每个都变成了 28-101 个 RoboToken 的序列——小到足以端到端地扩散。

sentences.en: RoboTokens are 27–110× more compact than MJCF text.
sentences.zh: RoboToken 比 MJCF 文本紧凑 27-110 倍。

sentences.en: A robot's full description fits in tens of typed tokens (blue counts) where a language tokenizer would need thousands (grey counts) — small enough that a transformer can diffuse them directly, rather than autoregressively writing XML.
sentences.zh: 机器人的完整描述适合数十个键入的标记（蓝色计数），而语言标记生成器需要数千个（灰色计数）——足够小，转换器可以直接扩散它们，而不是自回归地编写 XML。

blocks.html_en: PART 2

Transformer Transformer
A Unified Architecture

sentences.en: Transformer Transformer A Unified Architecture
sentences.zh: Transformer Transformer 统一架构

blocks.html_en: The model is a diffusion transformer (DiT1) trained on RoboTokens with a DDIM4 noise schedule. Noise is added to every input token except the ones we condition on — and by changing which tokens are masked, the same network wears different hats. Mask everything to get an unconditional robot generator. Mask the actions and you get a cross-embodiment controller5,6. Mask the embodiment and you get a motion-conditioned robot designer. Same weights, jointly trained on dynamics.

sentences.en: The model is a diffusion transformer (DiT1) trained on RoboTokens with a DDIM4 noise schedule.
sentences.zh: 该模型是一个扩散变压器 (DiT1)，使用 DDIM4 噪声表在 RoboToken 上进行训练。

sentences.en: Noise is added to every input token except the ones we condition on — and by changing which tokens are masked, the same network wears different hats.
sentences.zh: 除了我们所依赖的输入标记之外，每个输入标记都会添加噪声，并且通过更改被屏蔽的标记，同一网络会戴上不同的帽子。

sentences.en: Mask everything to get an unconditional robot generator.
sentences.zh: 掩盖一切以获得无条件的机器人发电机。

sentences.en: Mask the actions and you get a cross-embodiment controller5,6.
sentences.zh: 屏蔽这些动作，你就得到了一个跨实体控制器5,6。

sentences.en: Mask the embodiment and you get a motion-conditioned robot designer.
sentences.zh: 掩盖这个实施例，你就会得到一个运动调节机器人设计师。

sentences.en: Same weights, jointly trained on dynamics.
sentences.zh: 相同的权重，共同进行动力学训练。

blocks.html_en: (And about the pun: the first “Transformer” refers to robots whose embodiments can change. The second refers to the self-attention architecture 🥸)

sentences.en: (And about the pun: the first “Transformer” refers to robots whose embodiments can change.
sentences.zh: （关于双关语：第一个“变形金刚”指的是可以改变形态的机器人。

sentences.en: (a) Motion-to-robot optimization jointly diffuses embodiment and dynamics tokens.
sentences.zh: (a) 运动到机器人的优化共同扩散了体现和动态标记。

sentences.en: (b) Cross-embodiment control diffuses the actions, conditioned on the embodiment and the target motion.
sentences.zh: (b) 跨实施例控制以实施例和目标运动为条件分散动作。

sentences.en: At inference time, the model's own predictions are converted into a reward prediction whose gradients steer the generation toward higher-reward designs.
sentences.zh: 在推理时，模型自身的预测被转换为奖励预测，其梯度引导一代人走向更高奖励的设计。

We behavior-cloned whole-body controllers from RL experts7,8,9 trained one-per-design on the procedural quadruped space.

sentences.en: One policy, many quadrupeds.

sentences.zh: 现在是实际的协同设计问题：我们如何为模型在训练期间从未见过的奖励函数生成高奖励机器人？

blocks.html_en: Here is the trick. The same model predicts both the embodiment and its dynamics, so we can feed those predictions into the user's reward function and get a predicted reward. With predicted rewards in hand, we can run the model many times in parallel, predict the reward for each candidate, and return the best one. That is best-of-N sampling, but at GPU speed.

sentences.en: Here is the trick.
sentences.zh: 这就是窍门。

sentences.en: The same model predicts both the embodiment and its dynamics, so we can feed those predictions into the user's reward function and get a predicted reward.
sentences.zh: 相同的模型可以预测实施例及其动态，因此我们可以将这些预测输入到用户的奖励函数中并获得预测的奖励。

sentences.en: With predicted rewards in hand, we can run the model many times in parallel, predict the reward for each candidate, and return the best one.
sentences.zh: 有了预测奖励，我们可以并行运行模型多次，预测每个候选者的奖励，并返回最好的奖励。

sentences.en: That is best-of-N sampling, but at GPU speed.
sentences.zh: 这是 N 次最佳采样，但以 GPU 速度进行。

blocks.html_en: We can do better. Because the predicted reward is a differentiable function of the embodiment tokens, we can take its gradient and inject it back into the diffusion process — pushing samples toward higher reward at every denoising step, following classifier-guided DDIM11. The model is, in effect, asking itself: “how should this robot change to increase the reward?” We call this Dynamics Self-Guidance.

sentences.en: We can do better.
sentences.zh: 我们可以做得更好。

sentences.en: Because the predicted reward is a differentiable function of the embodiment tokens, we can take its gradient and inject it back into the diffusion process — pushing samples toward higher reward at every denoising step, following classifier-guided DDIM11.
sentences.zh: 因为预测的奖励是实施例标记的可微函数，所以我们可以获取其梯度并将其注入到扩散过程中——遵循分类器引导的 DDIM11，在每个去噪步骤中将样本推向更高的奖励。

sentences.en: The model is, in effect, asking itself: “how should this robot change to increase the reward?”
sentences.zh: 该模型实际上是在问自己：“这个机器人应该如何改变以增加奖励？”

sentences.en: We call this Dynamics Self-Guidance.
sentences.zh: 我们称之为动力学自引导。

blocks.html_en: Why “self-guidance”: related work that incorporates dynamics into diffusion guidance trains a separate dynamics model12 or relies on a differentiable simulator13. Here, the model uses its own dynamics predictions to steer itself.

sentences.en: Why “self-guidance”: related work that incorporates dynamics into diffusion guidance trains a separate dynamics model12 or relies on a differentiable simulator13.
sentences.zh: 为什么“自引导”：将动力学纳入扩散引导的相关工作训练单独的动力学模型12或依赖于可微分模拟器13。

sentences.en: Here, the model uses its own dynamics predictions to steer itself.
sentences.zh: 在这里，模型使用自己的动态预测来进行自我引导。

sentences.en: One gradient, the whole episode.
sentences.zh: 一个渐变，整个情节。

sentences.en: Transformer Transformer predicts state and action tokens across the episode's horizon in parallel; the reward gradient then flows back through all of it to the embodiment tokens.
sentences.zh: Transformer Transformer 并行预测情节范围内的状态和动作标记；然后奖励梯度通过所有梯度流回实施例代币。

sentences.en: Hardware gets optimized over long-horizon dynamics, not one timestep at a time.
sentences.zh: 硬件在长期动态上得到优化，而不是一次一个步骤。

blocks.html_en: Reward in, robot out

sentences.en: Reward in, robot out
sentences.zh: 奖励进来，机器人出去

blocks.html_en: Take a randomly-generated quadruped that falls during a dynamic toss. Ask our model to generate a robot for the same trajectory with only a tracking reward and it lowers the center of mass and widens the support polygon — stable design choices it discovered as a side-effect of trying to maximize tracking reward it has never seen.

sentences.en: Take a randomly-generated quadruped that falls during a dynamic toss.
sentences.zh: 以随机生成的四足动物为例，该四足动物在动态投掷过程中掉落。

sentences.en: Ask our model to generate a robot for the same trajectory with only a tracking reward and it lowers the center of mass and widens the support polygon — stable design choices it discovered as a side-effect of trying to maximize tracking reward it has never seen.
sentences.zh: 让我们的模型生成一个仅具有跟踪奖励的具有相同轨迹的机​​器人，它会降低质心并扩大支撑多边形——它发现稳定的设计选择是试图最大化跟踪奖励的副作用，它从未见过。

blocks.html_en: Now add a torque-penalty term and the optimization landscape shifts. The model returns a smaller, lighter robot — still tracking the motion, but using 30% less average torque. Add a size penalty and the landscape shifts again. This is what people might call zero-shotting rewards: train on dynamics modeling, optimize at inference for any reward you can write down.

sentences.en: Now add a torque-penalty term and the optimization landscape shifts.
sentences.zh: 现在添加扭矩惩罚项，优化情况就会发生变化。

sentences.en: The model returns a smaller, lighter robot — still tracking the motion, but using 30% less average torque.
sentences.zh: 该模型返回一个更小、更轻的机器人——仍然跟踪运动，但使用的平均扭矩减少了 30%。

sentences.en: Add a size penalty and the landscape shifts again.
sentences.zh: 添加尺寸惩罚后，景观会再次发生变化。

sentences.en: This is what people might call zero-shotting rewards: train on dynamics modeling, optimize at inference for any reward you can write down.
sentences.zh: 这就是人们所说的零射击奖励：训练动态建模，优化推理以获得你可以写下的任何奖励。

sentences.en: Same model, different conditioning, different robots.
sentences.zh: 相同的模型，不同的条件，不同的机器人。

sentences.en: Swapping the target trajectory (Floor Scrub → Dynamic Toss) or adding a size penalty reshapes the optimization landscape, and the generated embodiments shift accordingly — without retraining.
sentences.zh: 交换目标轨迹（地板擦洗 → 动态抛掷）或添加尺寸惩罚可以重塑优化景观，并且生成的实施例会相应地发生变化 - 无需重新训练。

sentences.en: Discrete choices (leg design, DoF) and continuous choices (link length, mounting point) both vary in response.
sentences.zh: 离散选择（腿设计、自由度）和连续选择（链接长度、安装点）的响应都不同。

blocks.html_en: Composing diffusion models for whole datasets

sentences.en: Composing diffusion models for whole datasets
sentences.zh: 为整个数据集构建扩散模型

blocks.html_en: Manipulation isn't one motion; it's a distribution of motions. We want to optimize a robot for an entire task — say, dish washing — not a single trajectory. Diffusion composition14,15 lets us do exactly this: run the model in parallel with different trajectories as conditioning, average the predicted noise at each diffusion step, and you get a generator optimized for all of them simultaneously.

sentences.en: Manipulation isn't one motion; it's a distribution of motions.
sentences.zh: 操纵不是一个动作，而是一个动作。这是运动的分布。

sentences.en: We want to optimize a robot for an entire task — say, dish washing — not a single trajectory.
sentences.zh: 我们希望优化机器人的整个任务（例如洗碗），而不是单个轨迹。

sentences.en: Diffusion composition14,15 lets us do exactly this: run the model in parallel with different trajectories as conditioning, average the predicted noise at each diffusion step, and you get a generator optimized for all of them simultaneously.
sentences.zh: 扩散合成 14,15 让我们能够做到这一点：以不同的轨迹并行运行模型作为条件，对每个扩散步骤的预测噪声进行平均，然后您将得到一个同时针对所有这些噪声进行优化的生成器。

blocks.html_en: We tested this on the publicly-available UMI bimanual dish-washing dataset3, holding out 26 validation trajectories. Transformer Transformer generated robots optimized over the entire held-out distribution — navigating both the discrete space (spine designs: fixed, sliding, bending) and the continuous space (arm dimensions, mounting offsets) — and the same model then served as the cross-embodiment controller to validate each generated design.

sentences.en: We tested this on the publicly-available UMI bimanual dish-washing dataset3, holding out 26 validation trajectories.
sentences.zh: 我们在公开可用的 UMI 双手洗碗数据集3 上对此进行了测试，提供了 26 个验证轨迹。

sentences.en: Transformer Transformer generated robots optimized over the entire held-out distribution — navigating both the discrete space (spine designs: fixed, sliding, bending) and the continuous space (arm dimensions, mounting offsets) — and the same model then served as the cross-embodiment controller to validate each generated design.
sentences.zh: Transformer Transformer 生成的机器人在整个保留分布上进行了优化 - 导航离散空间（脊柱设计：固定、滑动、弯曲）和连续空间（手臂尺寸、安装偏移） - 然后使用相同的模型作为跨实施例控制器来验证每个生成的设计。

blocks.html_en: One robot, a whole task. Composed across the 26 held-out UMI dish-washing trajectories, the model returns a single embodiment optimized for the entire distribution — and the same network then drives it through each motion.

sentences.en: One robot, a whole task.
sentences.zh: 一个机器人，完成一项任务。

sentences.en: Composed across the 26 held-out UMI dish-washing trajectories, the model returns a single embodiment optimized for the entire distribution — and the same network then drives it through each motion.
sentences.zh: 该模型由 26 个保留的 UMI 洗碗轨迹组成，返回针对整个分布进行优化的单个实施例，然后由同一网络驱动它完成每个动作。

blocks.html_en: Better Designs, Faster

sentences.en: Better Designs, Faster
sentences.zh: 更好的设计，更快

blocks.html_en: We compare against two baselines: Random (sample a robot from the procedural design space) and CMA-ES16, a black-box optimizer widely used in co-design. CMA-ES rolls out candidate robots in MuJoCo17 with the design space's controller (Mink18 for fixed-base / bimanual; an RL expert7 for legged robots), then biases the next generation toward higher-reward samples.

sentences.en: We compare against two baselines: Random (sample a robot from the procedural design space) and CMA-ES16, a black-box optimizer widely used in co-design.
sentences.zh: 我们与两个基线进行比较：随机（从程序设计空间中对机器人进行采样）和 CMA-ES16（一种广泛用于协同设计的黑盒优化器）。

sentences.en: CMA-ES rolls out candidate robots in MuJoCo17 with the design space's controller (Mink18 for fixed-base / bimanual; an RL expert7 for legged robots), then biases the next generation toward higher-reward samples.
sentences.zh: CMA-ES 在 MuJoCo17 中推出带有设计空间控制器的候选机器人（用于固定底座/双手的 Mink18；用于腿式机器人的 RL Expert7），然后将下一代偏向于更高奖励的样本。

blocks.html_en: We give all methods the same task: generate a robot for a target trajectory and reward, control it, report the achieved reward.

sentences.en: We give all methods the same task: generate a robot for a target trajectory and reward, control it, report the achieved reward.
sentences.zh: 我们给所有方法赋予相同的任务：生成一个具有目标轨迹和奖励的机器人，控制它，报告所获得的奖励。

blocks.html_en: Test-time compute scales the results

sentences.en: Test-time compute scales the results
sentences.zh: 测试时计算可缩放结果

blocks.html_en: Like large language models that get better with longer thinking19, Transformer Transformer gets better designs when given more inference seeds to sample over. Performance does eventually plateau after about a minute — unlike the seemingly endless gains LLMs get from longer reasoning. We discuss this in the limitations.

sentences.en: Like large language models that get better with longer thinking19, Transformer Transformer gets better designs when given more inference seeds to sample over.
sentences.zh: 就像大型语言模型会随着思考时间的延长而变得更好19一样，Transformer 在提供更多推理种子进行采样时会获得更好的设计。

sentences.en: Performance does eventually plateau after about a minute — unlike the seemingly endless gains LLMs get from longer reasoning.
sentences.zh: 大约一分钟后，性能最终会达到稳定水平——这与法学硕士从较长的推理中获得的看似无穷无尽的收益不同。

sentences.en: We discuss this in the limitations.
sentences.zh: 我们在限制中讨论这一点。

sentences.en: Higher reward, orders of magnitude faster.
sentences.zh: 奖励更高，速度更快。

sentences.en: Across three design spaces and several reward functions, our Zeroth Order and Dynamics Self-Guidance variants both produce higher-reward designs as more parallel samples are allowed — and both reach CMA-ES-level quality in seconds rather than hours.
sentences.zh: 在三个设计空间和多个奖励函数中，我们的零阶和动力学自引导变体都可以产生更高奖励的设计，因为允许更多的并行样本，并且都可以在几秒钟而不是几小时内达到 CMA-ES 级别的质量。

sentences.en: For multi-trajectory bimanual optimization (rightmost), CMA-ES took 3+ hours; our model finished in under a minute.
sentences.zh: 对于多轨迹双手优化（最右边），CMA-ES 花费了 3 个多小时；我们的模型在一分钟内就完成了。

blocks.html_en: Why so much faster? Two reasons multiply. (1) GPU parallelization over candidate designs. (2) Non-autoregressive diffusion evaluates an entire rollout in parallel rather than one timestep at a time. Typical learned dynamics models predict one step at a time; we predict the whole episode at once.

sentences.en: Why so much faster?
sentences.zh: 为什么这么快？

sentences.en: Two reasons multiply.
sentences.zh: 有两个原因倍增。

sentences.en: (1) GPU parallelization over candidate designs.
sentences.zh: (1) 候选设计的 GPU 并行化。

sentences.en: (2) Non-autoregressive diffusion evaluates an entire rollout in parallel rather than one timestep at a time.
sentences.zh: (2) 非自回归扩散并行评估整个推出，而不是一次评估一个时间步长。

sentences.en: Typical learned dynamics models predict one step at a time; we predict the whole episode at once.
sentences.zh: 典型的学习动力学模型一次预测一步；我们立即预测整个情节。

blocks.html_en: Real-World: Cloth Flinging on ALOHA

sentences.en: Real-World: Cloth Flinging on ALOHA
sentences.zh: 现实世界：ALOHA 上的布料投掷

blocks.html_en: Original ALOHA vs Transformer Transformer-optimized ALOHA. Same task, same target trajectory, two robots. The optimized design unfolds the cloth where the original cannot.

sentences.en: Original ALOHA vs Transformer Transformer-optimized ALOHA.
sentences.zh: 原始 ALOHA 与 Transformer 变压器优化的 ALOHA。

sentences.en: Same task, same target trajectory, two robots.
sentences.zh: 相同的任务，相同的目标轨迹，两个机器人。

sentences.en: The optimized design unfolds the cloth where the original cannot.
sentences.zh: 优化的设计使布料展开，而原始设计无法展开。

blocks.html_en: To stress-test the whole system on hardware, we picked dynamic cloth unfolding on ALOHA2. Flinging20 punishes embodiment mistakes through both kinematics (the arm has to reach over the cloth at high speed) and unmodeled dynamics (aerodynamic drag, cloth weight, friction). The original ALOHA design struggled to even track the trajectory.

sentences.en: To stress-test the whole system on hardware, we picked dynamic cloth unfolding on ALOHA2.
sentences.zh: 为了对整个系统进行硬件压力测试，我们选择了 ALOHA2 上的动态布料展开。

sentences.en: Flinging20 punishes embodiment mistakes through both kinematics (the arm has to reach over the cloth at high speed) and unmodeled dynamics (aerodynamic drag, cloth weight, friction).
sentences.zh: Flinging20 通过运动学（手臂必须高速到达布料）和未建模的动力学（空气动力阻力、布料重量、摩擦力）来惩罚实施错误。

sentences.en: The original ALOHA design struggled to even track the trajectory.
sentences.zh: 最初的 ALOHA 设计甚至很难追踪轨迹。

blocks.html_en: We asked our model to optimize the ALOHA design for the “Tracking Velocity” reward, then fabricated the resulting design. Two things changed compared to the original:

sentences.en: We asked our model to optimize the ALOHA design for the “Tracking Velocity” reward, then fabricated the resulting design.
sentences.zh: 我们要求我们的模型优化 ALOHA 设计以获得“跟踪速度”奖励，然后制作最终的设计。

sentences.en: Two things changed compared to the original:
sentences.zh: 与原版相比，有两点发生了变化：

blocks.html_en: • Longer link lengths. Just enough to kinematically reach across the flinging trajectory, but light enough to stay within the Dynamixel motor torque envelope.

sentences.en: Longer link lengths.
sentences.zh: 更长的链接长度。

sentences.en: Just enough to kinematically reach across the flinging trajectory, but light enough to stay within the Dynamixel motor torque envelope.
sentences.zh: 刚好足以在运动学上跨越投掷轨迹，但又足够轻以保持在 Dynamixel 电机扭矩范围内。

blocks.html_en: • Inverted mounting. The arms hang upside-down behind the workspace, enabling an energy-efficient underarm swing instead of an overhead fling.

sentences.en: Inverted mounting.
sentences.zh: 倒置安装。

sentences.en: The arms hang upside-down behind the workspace, enabling an energy-efficient underarm swing instead of an overhead fling.
sentences.zh: 手臂倒挂在工作空间后面，实现节能的腋下摆动，而不是头顶上的投掷。

sentences.en: Smoother joint trajectories.
sentences.zh: 更平滑的关节轨迹。

sentences.en: Joint speed over the flinging motion.
sentences.zh: 关节速度高于投掷运动。

sentences.en: The optimized design has fewer peaks and a lower maximum than the original — the kinematic and dynamic gains transfer to hardware.
sentences.zh: 优化后的设计比原始设计具有更少的峰值和更低的最大值——运动学和动态增益转移到硬件。

sentences.en: Limitations & Future Work
sentences.zh: 局限性和未来的工作

blocks.html_en: Geometry and scene. RoboTokens currently cover primitive-based geometry, not arbitrary meshes or deformables, and don't yet encode the surrounding scene or contact targets. Extending to complex geometry and scene context is a clear next step toward fully task-conditioned co-design.

sentences.en: Geometry and scene.
sentences.zh: 几何和场景。

sentences.en: RoboTokens currently cover primitive-based geometry, not arbitrary meshes or deformables, and don't yet encode the surrounding scene or contact targets.
sentences.zh: RoboToken 目前涵盖基于基元的几何体，而不是任意网格或可变形物体，并且尚未对周围场景或接触目标进行编码。

sentences.en: Extending to complex geometry and scene context is a clear next step toward fully task-conditioned co-design.
sentences.zh: 扩展到复杂的几何图形和场景环境是实现完全任务条件协同设计的明确下一步。

blocks.html_en: Controller transfer. Our cross-embodiment controller correlates with the RL oracle at Pearson r = 0.53 on diffused embodiments — promising but with headroom. Some outlier embodiments expose where the controller fails to generalize.

sentences.en: Controller transfer.
sentences.zh: 控制器转移。

sentences.zh: 我们的跨实施例控制器与扩散实施例中 Pearson r = 0.53 的 RL 预言机相关——很有希望，但有空间。

sentences.en: Some outlier embodiments expose where the controller fails to generalize.
sentences.zh: 一些异常实施例暴露了控制器无法概括的地方。

blocks.html_en: Test-time scaling plateau. Like other guided-diffusion methods, our test-time compute gains plateau after about a minute. Unlike LLMs19, more inference time stops helping past a point. Improving reward-prediction accuracy and alternative inference schemes are open directions.

sentences.en: Test-time scaling plateau.
sentences.zh: 测试时间缩放平台。

sentences.en: Like other guided-diffusion methods, our test-time compute gains plateau after about a minute.
sentences.zh: 与其他引导扩散方法一样，我们的测试时间计算在大约一分钟后达到稳定水平。

sentences.en: Unlike LLMs19, more inference time stops helping past a point.
sentences.zh: 与法学硕士 19 不同，更多的推理时间将不再有帮助。

sentences.en: Improving reward-prediction accuracy and alternative inference schemes are open directions.
sentences.zh: 提高奖励预测的准确性和替代推理方案是开放的方向。

blocks.html_en: Data generation cost. RL-based whole-body controller data generation is expensive (one RL expert per discrete design choice, 16 hours of A100 per policy). Scaling Transformer Transformer to new design spaces hinges on reducing this cost.

content_html_zh:
变压器 变压器

Huy Ha, Karen Liu, Shuran Song

并非所有机器人都是生来平等的

并非所有机器人都是生而平等的——但如果你可以为特定任务设计一个机器人呢？ 我们提出了 Transformer Transformer，这是一个统一的模型，它正是这样做的：给它一个操作演示，它会生成一个完整的机器人——每个连杆、关节、电机和惯性属性——针对该运动进行了优化。 我们制作了这样一种设计，用于在 ALOHA2 双手平台上投掷布料；与原来相比，它减少了 73% 的跟踪误差和 30% 的最大关节速度。

该结果背后是一个在 RoboToken 上训练的扩散转换器，这是机器人实施例、状态和动作的统一标记。 相同的架构跨越实施例空间（轮式双手、四足动物、类人机器人）和用例（实施例生成、跨实施例控制）。 它不是过度拟合一个奖励函数，而是一种动态模型，其与奖励无关的预测在推理时被转换为奖励特定的值预测，然后用于通过我们称为动态自我指导的过程来引导体现扩散。 三个设计空间的实验表明，对看不见的奖励和轨迹进行了零样本优化，在进化基线上提高了性能和运行时间。

技术摘要视频

17 分钟的演练 - 或滚动查看图形和标题版本。

对于给定的操作任务来说，什么是最好的机器人？

机器人的具体体现决定了它能胜任哪些任务。 我们努力让机器人变得更智能——更大的数据集、更好的算法、更强大的政策架构——但糟糕的实施甚至可能会阻碍一项伟大的政策。 您可以收集世界上所有的投掷数据，但如果您的机器人的形状远非最佳，它可能会投掷自己而不是球。

那么让我们具体地描述一下这个问题。 给定目标末端执行器运动和奖励函数作为输入，我们希望为该任务生成一个完整的机器人实施例 - 我们所说的完整是指每个链接、关节、电机和惯性属性，以及驱动整个物体的控制器。 我们将这种运动调节机器人称为协同设计。

一个随机程序生成的机器人尝试目标运动：它在完成之前就摔倒了 🙃

演示、生成、验证

我们的框架将机器人协同设计重新构建为一个三步过程：您演示所需的末端执行器运动（例如，来自 UMI3 人体演示），我们的模型生成优化的实施例，并且同一模型通过直接控制设计来验证设计。 同一网络通过对机器人的统一标记化进行联合训练，扮演三个角色：生成器、评论家和跨实施例控制器。

论文分为三个部分：统一的机器人表示（RoboTokens）、统一的架构（Transformer Transformer）和统一的训练目标（Dynamics Self-Guidance）。 直到架构部分你才能弄清楚双关语🥸

PART 1

RoboTokens 统一的机器人表示

如果我们想要一个模型来共同设计任何机器人，网络需要一个跨越每个实施例的共享词汇表。 RoboTokens 就是这样的词汇表：每个链接、关节、电机、状态和动作的键入令牌 — 被组织起来，以便单个序列描述机器人的体现（时不变）及其动态（时变）。

RoboTokens 有以下主要设计目标：

  • 完全的。 RoboToken 序列捕获有关刚性关节式机器人的所有内容：5 种实施例令牌类型（连杆、固定关节、旋转/滑动关节、球关节、电机）以及状态和动作令牌。
  • 灵活的。 令牌通过 ID 相互引用——关节令牌知道它连接的两个链接令牌——因此相同的格式可以处理 6 自由度手臂或 35 自由度两足动物。
  • 持续的。 分词器规范化冗余空间偏移并将惯性/变换数据存储在单个帧中，从而减少模型必须学习的方差。
  • 可扩展。 新的令牌类型无需更改架构即可插入 - 我们通过将目标末端执行器姿势令牌指向相关的末端执行器和时间步 ID 来添加用于轨迹跟踪的令牌，无需对机器人的其余部分进行重新令牌化。
  • 可优化。 与 MJCF 等自回归文本格式不同，扩散连续值 RoboToken 既具有全局可控性（后来的令牌在去噪步骤中影响早期的令牌）又具有可微性——这是推理时基于梯度的奖励优化所需的两个要素。

我们对来自 MuJoCo Menagerie10 的 11 个机器人进行了标记，其质量跨越两个数量级（0.65 公斤灵巧手到 67.5 公斤四足动物）和 6 到 35 个活动关节。 每个都变成了 28-101 个 RoboToken 的序列——小到足以端到端地扩散。

PART 2

Transformer Transformer 统一架构

该模型是一个扩散变压器 (DiT1)，使用 DDIM4 噪声表在 RoboToken 上进行训练。 除了我们所依赖的输入标记之外，每个输入标记都会添加噪声，并且通过更改被屏蔽的标记，同一网络会戴上不同的帽子。 掩盖一切以获得无条件的机器人发电机。 屏蔽这些动作，你就得到了一个跨实体控制器5,6。 掩盖这个实施例，你就会得到一个运动调节机器人设计师。 相同的权重，共同进行动力学训练。

（关于双关语：第一个“变形金刚”指的是可以改变形态的机器人。 第二个指的是 self-attention 架构🥸）

实施例感知控制器

因为控制器将完整的实施例视为输入，所以它可以根据其驱动的机器人调整其控制策略。 改变连杆惯性、关节范围或电机增益，相同的策略会持续跟踪——无需对每个机器人进行任何重新训练。 我们通过 RL 专家7、8、9 的行为克隆全身控制器在程序四足动物空间上对每个设计进行了训练。

一项政策，许多四足动物。 相同的控制器通过连续变化（链接尺寸）和离散变化（自由度、膝盖方向、弹簧加载与串行腿）来跟踪四足动物的相同轨迹。

不同机器人类别的生成器

在完全不进行任何调节的情况下运行模型，它可以将完整的机器人从高斯噪声中扩散出来。 在 Menagerie10 的各种机器人上进行训练后，一台 Transformer Transformer 可以产生固定底座手臂、四足动物、人形机器人和灵巧的手。 因为扩散是随机的，所以每次运行都会给出不同的机器人。

机器人，分散。 单个模型根据相同的噪声表生成固定底座手臂、四足动物、类人动物和灵巧的手。

PART 3

动力学自导零射击奖励

现在是实际的协同设计问题：我们如何为模型在训练期间从未见过的奖励函数生成高奖励机器人？

这就是窍门。 相同的模型可以预测实施例及其动态，因此我们可以将这些预测输入到用户的奖励函数中并获得预测的奖励。 有了预测奖励，我们可以并行运行模型多次，预测每个候选者的奖励，并返回最好的奖励。 这是 N 次最佳采样，但以 GPU 速度进行。

我们可以做得更好。 因为预测的奖励是实施例标记的可微函数，所以我们可以获取其梯度并将其注入到扩散过程中——遵循分类器引导的 DDIM11，在每个去噪步骤中将样本推向更高的奖励。 该模型实际上是在问自己：“这个机器人应该如何改变以增加奖励？” 我们称之为动力学自引导。

为什么“自引导”：将动力学纳入扩散引导的相关工作训练单独的动力学模型12或依赖于可微分模拟器13。 在这里，模型使用自己的动态预测来进行自我引导。

奖励进来，机器人出去

以随机生成的四足动物为例，该四足动物在动态投掷过程中掉落。 让我们的模型生成一个仅具有跟踪奖励的具有相同轨迹的机​​器人，它会降低质心并扩大支撑多边形——它发现稳定的设计选择是试图最大化跟踪奖励的副作用，它从未见过。

现在添加扭矩惩罚项，优化情况就会发生变化。 该模型返回一个更小、更轻的机器人——仍然跟踪运动，但使用的平均扭矩减少了 30%。 添加尺寸惩罚后，景观会再次发生变化。 这就是人们所说的零射击奖励：训练动态建模，优化推理以获得你可以写下的任何奖励。

为整个数据集构建扩散模型

操纵不是一个动作，而是一个动作。这是运动的分布。 我们希望优化机器人的整个任务（例如洗碗），而不是单个轨迹。 扩散合成 14,15 让我们能够做到这一点：以不同的轨迹并行运行模型作为条件，对每个扩散步骤的预测噪声进行平均，然后您将得到一个同时针对所有这些噪声进行优化的生成器。

我们在公开可用的 UMI 双手洗碗数据集3 上对此进行了测试，提供了 26 个验证轨迹。 Transformer Transformer 生成的机器人在整个保留分布上进行了优化 - 导航离散空间（脊柱设计：固定、滑动、弯曲）和连续空间（手臂尺寸、安装偏移） - 然后使用相同的模型作为跨实施例控制器来验证每个生成的设计。

一个机器人，完成一项任务。 该模型由 26 个保留的 UMI 洗碗轨迹组成，返回针对整个分布进行优化的单个实施例，然后由同一网络驱动它完成每个动作。

更好的设计，更快

我们与两个基线进行比较：随机（从程序设计空间中对机器人进行采样）和 CMA-ES16（一种广泛用于协同设计的黑盒优化器）。 CMA-ES 在 MuJoCo17 中推出带有设计空间控制器的候选机器人（用于固定底座/双手的 Mink18；用于腿式机器人的 RL Expert7），然后将下一代偏向于更高奖励的样本。

我们给所有方法赋予相同的任务：生成一个具有目标轨迹和奖励的机器人，控制它，报告所获得的奖励。

测试时计算可缩放结果

就像大型语言模型会随着思考时间的延长而变得更好19一样，Transformer 在提供更多推理种子进行采样时会获得更好的设计。 大约一分钟后，性能最终会达到稳定水平——这与法学硕士从较长的推理中获得的看似无穷无尽的收益不同。 我们在限制中讨论这一点。

为什么这么快？ 有两个原因倍增。 (1) 候选设计的 GPU 并行化。 (2) 非自回归扩散并行评估整个推出，而不是一次评估一个时间步长。 典型的学习动力学模型一次预测一步；我们立即预测整个情节。

现实世界：ALOHA 上的布料投掷

原始 ALOHA 与 Transformer 变压器优化的 ALOHA。 相同的任务，相同的目标轨迹，两个机器人。 优化的设计使布料展开，而原始设计无法展开。

为了对整个系统进行硬件压力测试，我们选择了 ALOHA2 上的动态布料展开。 Flinging20 通过运动学（手臂必须高速到达布料）和未建模的动力学（空气动力阻力、布料重量、摩擦力）来惩罚实施错误。 最初的 ALOHA 设计甚至很难追踪轨迹。

我们要求我们的模型优化 ALOHA 设计以获得“跟踪速度”奖励，然后制作最终的设计。 与原版相比，有两点发生了变化：

  • 更长的链接长度。 刚好足以在运动学上跨越投掷轨迹，但又足够轻以保持在 Dynamixel 电机扭矩范围内。
  • 倒置安装。 手臂倒挂在工作空间后面，实现节能的腋下摆动，而不是头顶上的投掷。

局限性和未来的工作

几何和场景。 RoboToken 目前涵盖基于基元的几何体，而不是任意网格或可变形物体，并且尚未对周围场景或接触目标进行编码。 扩展到复杂的几何图形和场景环境是实现完全任务条件协同设计的明确下一步。

控制器转移。 我们的跨实施例控制器与扩散实施例中 Pearson r = 0.53 的 RL 预言机相关——很有希望，但有空间。 一些异常实施例暴露了控制器无法概括的地方。

测试时间缩放平台。 与其他引导扩散方法一样，我们的测试时间计算在大约一分钟后达到稳定水平。 与法学硕士 19 不同，更多的推理时间将不再有帮助。 提高奖励预测的准确性和替代推理方案是开放的方向。

数据生成成本。 基于 RL 的全身控制器数据生成成本高昂（每个离散设计选择需要一名 RL 专家，每个策略需要 16 小时的 A100）。 将 Transformer Transformer 扩展到新的设计空间取决于降低成本。
